easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mercurial Pretender.
description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Mercurial Pretender enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Mercurial Pretender. Choose to have Mercurial Pretender enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
